headline: Profit surges as spending cuts bite; guidance raised
summary_short: Revenue rose 14% to $952M and Adjusted EBITDA doubled to $229M, well above the $190M-$210M guidance range. CoStar raised 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $820M-$840M.
summary_long: Net income was $74M versus a $31M loss a year ago, and Adjusted EPS rose 65% to $0.38. Selling and marketing expense fell to $366M from $418M. Management expects about $150M of cost savings this year versus original guidance and has identified at least $200M more over 12-18 months, keeping a 2028 Adjusted EBITDA target of $1.25B. Revenue guidance for 2026 is $3.75B-$3.77B; Q4 revenue is guided to $976M-$996M.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EPS are non-GAAP; adjusted EPS uses an assumed 26% tax rate. Adjusted EBITDA delta is the release's own statement that it doubled.

drivers.explanation: Significant additional efficiencies brought anticipated 2026 cost savings to about $150M versus original guidance as the company exits a period of investment.
CEO says margins are expanding on cost efficiencies, with an ongoing expense review finding at least $200M more savings, and cites AI and proprietary data as advantages.
